crew.overview: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy

crew.overview: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

crew.original_title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
crew.overview: On a mission to make Christmas unforgettable for Quill, the Guardians head to Earth in search of the perfect present.
crew.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

crew.overview: Peter Quill, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission that, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3

crew.original_title: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies
crew.overview: All the major DC superheroes are starring in their own films, all but the Teen Titans, so Robin is determined to remedy this situation by getting over his role as a sidekick and becoming a movie star. Thus, with a few madcap ideas and an inspirational song in their hearts, the Teen Titans head to Hollywood to fulfill their dreams.
crew.title: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies

crew.original_title: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans
crew.overview: The comedic modern-day quintet takes on their 2003 counterparts when villains from each of their worlds join forces to pit the two Titan teams against each other. They'll need to set aside their differences and work together to combat Trigon, Hexagon, Santa Claus (that's right, Santa!) and time itself in order to save the multiverse.
crew.title: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans

crew.overview: When innocent civilians begin committing unthinkable crimes across Metropolis, Gotham City and beyond, Batman must call upon mystical counterparts to eradicate this demonic threat to the planet; enter Justice League Dark. This team of Dark Arts specialists must unravel the mystery of Earth's supernatural plague and contend with the rising, powerful villainous forces behind the siege—before it's too late for all of mankind.
crew.title: Justice League Dark

details.biography:
Arnold Drake (March 1, 1924 – March 12, 2007) was an American comic book writer and screenwriter best known for co-creating the DC Comics characters Deadman and the Doom Patrol, and the Marvel Comics characters the Guardians of the Galaxy, among others.

Drake was posthumously inducted into the Will Eisner Comic Book Hall of Fame in 2008.
